tags.validation_note: Re-audited 2026-11-13: sources conflict on the shark species behind the name (Aqua TCI: nurse sharks breed here; Dive Provo and dive-the-world.com: reef sharks) and on depth (Dive Provo shelf at 80-100ft/24-30m; dive-the-world.com chimney from 80ft/24m to wall at 130ft/40m, max 150ft/46m). Max depth raised 24->30m to match the shelf depth.

Re-audited 2026-11-13: previously listed 'reef sharks, oceanic triggerfish, spotted eagle rays' were not in any fetched source and were removed. Xtreme Spots reports avg 19.8m / max 33.5m (depth raised 24->33m); dive-the-world.com describes the black coral overhang at 70-90ft (21-27m). Times of the Islands (timespub.tc) only names Black Coral Forest as a Northwest Point Marine National Park site, so it is a weak third source. originaldiving.com returned HTTP 403 and could not be re-checked.
Re-audited 2026-11-13. Dive Provo gives a sand bottom at 85ft (26m) below the undercut. divewithmia.com was not re-fetched and is dropped from validation_source.

Coordinates corrected 2026-07-07 (approx. 21.49,-72.22, west of French Cay). Re-audited 2026-11-13: Zentacle and Wannadive both reproduce the same March 2012 Dive Provo guide account, so they are NOT independent of each other; independent corroboration comes from aquatci.com, diveprovo.com and dive-the-world.com. Difficulty lowered Advanced->Intermediate: Zentacle lists Beginner (max 60ft) and Wannadive lists CMAS*/Open Water with medium current (1-2 kn) and max 30.5m; Intermediate chosen as a compromise given the 45-minute boat ride and wall dropping past 30m. thescubadirectory.com was not re-fetched and is dropped.

Re-audited 2026-11-13: this is NOT a wreck (Grand Turk wall site near Governor's Beach). Deepblu log records boat entry. scubadiving.place reports avg 26m, reviews 12-27m, ~1kn current, no entry type stated. Previously listed '75ft visibility', 'sandy bottom ~40ft', 'ledge ~70ft' and moray/stingray sightings could not be re-verified and were removed. Garden eels from Frommer's/scubadiving.com search results.

Re-audited 2026-11-13: correction to the 2026-07-07 note. The Visit TCI shipwrecks catalogue does not list it, but Visit TCI's wreck-diving page (visittci.com/nature-and-history/history/wreck-diving) does mention a 'Southwind freighter' wreck near the W.E. freighter that 'today consists only of some loose debris'. A 2009 DiveBuddy listing (seen only in search-result excerpts; page could not be fetched) reportedly describes a debris field in 60-80ft of water at the wall edge, which conflicts with the recorded 15m / shore / Beginner values. No vessel build date, length, tonnage or sinking cause found in any source. Left validated=false (only one fetched source).

Re-audited 2026-11-13: entry_type corrected boat->shore (Visit TCI: shore access only, walk in from Lower Bight Road beach accesses; Islands.com: footpath from Grace Bay). Visit TCI describes it as a snorkeling site (scuba not mentioned); depth 15-20ft (4.5-6m) at outer reaches. Species list restored from Visit TCI, which names them for this reef.

Coordinates corrected 2026-07-07 (moved to Northwest Point cluster). Re-audited 2026-11-13: hole drops from 55ft (17m) to wall face at 90-95ft (27-29m), one diver at a time (Xtreme Spots, Dive Provo, dive-the-world.com). aquatci.com and visittci.com did not cover this site and were dropped.

Re-audited 2026-11-13: aggregate entry for the whole West Caicos wall. Park size corrected 981->1,153 acres (Visit TCI). Wall length conflicts (previous '6 miles' unsupported; dive-the-world.com says about 2 miles / ~12 sites). The Dive Globe lists max 35m, avg 20m and Intermediate difficulty; Advanced retained pending a second source. originaldiving.com returned HTTP 403.
